description: Canonical OCR fixture manifest (AHAIET-003): the single source of truth for fixture ids, image filenames, and ground-truth references. training/ocr/generate_fixtures.py writes exactly these filenames, and the Playwright specs in frontend/e2e read this same manifest instead of hardcoding names. Ground truth text itself lives in training/datasets/fixtures/sample_passages.jsonl (real corpus text) and in ground_truth.json next to this file.
